$comment: The fleet record (ADR-004): one entry per deployed instance of federal-mcps.
Nothing else in the repository names an AWS account or region. Consumers:
infra/ (CDK reads the instance selected by FEDERAL_MCPS_INSTANCE, default dev)
Adding a stage or a dedicated deployment is adding a record here and running the
one-time bootstrap runbook in that account with rc-deploy (ADR-006).

instances.name: dev
instances.description: federal-mcps dev in the Responsive City account
